place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: I love the nature vibe it’s giving. If you want a simple but relaxing spot, you can try this cafe. Super love their cheesecake especially when paired with their coffee. Every visit is always a good experience for me.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: love the vibe and greenery here. perfect place to read and just chill out. they also have an indoor seating with only few tables if you prefer with AC. matcha is very umami and the cheesecake was superb. does accept cashless and card payments but may be hard if scan to pay bc the signal inside the bldg is kinda wonky.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: We were looking for a café around the area and stumbled by this café. We had no choice because the nearby cafés were already full. It is worth noting that the guy who took our order had an unwelcoming and rude approach. He seems irritated taking our order and was always on his phone. Impolite. The other staff were cool and kind tho. Most of the food options were unavailable and the staff didn’t have remorse for it. Coffee was good considering its price.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: A cozy and comforting spot to relax. The cafe has a warm, homey atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer. I really enjoyed their cheesecake it was creamy and delicious, though the crust was a bit too sweet for my taste. Still, it's paired nicely with their coffee, making the overall experience worthwhile.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The best thing about Cafe Prelaya is its cozy vibe. That to me is a 5/5. We stayed at the garden for our early morning breakfast. We ordered pasta, grilled cheese sandwich, and coffee. Coffee was average. The grilled cheese sandwich was tasty. The pasta dishes we had were pretty average too. But do try their caramel pecan cheesecake. Suggestion: maybe add some salads or healthy wraps.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: A lovely place to have cup of coffee. They're open to serve as early as 6 am. Overall a solid 5 out of 5 stars ⭐

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: What I love about this place is its chill vibe. The atmosphere is perfect for relaxation and unwinding. Additionally, the food is absolutely fantastic, especially the pecan cheesecake, which is a delectable treat for the taste buds. Another thing that I adore about this place is their Spanish latte, which is a delightful and flavorful beverage. Moreover, I greatly appreciate the stunning wall art that graces the establishment. The artwork adds a lovely touch and enhances the overall ambiance.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: So far with what we've tried, food was good. The drinks are not bad either. We tried their bestseller pecan cheesecake and matcha latte. Since it was al fresco and that time it drizzled a little bit, we noticed numerous caterpillars on the grounds. They weren't getting in our food and causing annoyance though, so it seemed fine. I dont think they have a bigger indoor area, not sure. Will come back and try other items in their menu next time.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Cafe Prelaya offers delightful cheesecake and drinks in a charming setting adorned with a cute plant mural. While the food and drinks are delightful, the staff could benefit from additional training in customer service. During my visit, I requested water, and the response was less accommodating than expected, with the staff suggesting I get it outside the door. Considering the lack of other customers, a more attentive approach to customer service could enhance the overall experience and encourage repeat visits.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Signs of life at 6 a.m. has in itself earned my thumbs-up. Was welcomed by a yawning-under-his-hoodie-yet-wide-eyed barista. Open-air seating makes up most of the area. By half past 7, Hibiscus tonic in hand, I was out the door. Cheesecakes generally, are too much for me but my, oh, my their CARAMEL PECAN cheesecake was a standout. Orange Brew and Plain Cheesecake the following week also did not fail a nod.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The atmosphere was pleasant. The staff were so friendly and helpful. Contrary to the info that received regarding the being owner so strict. It is a good place to spend time with friends or loosen up with a sip of coffee. During our visit, it drizzled and the staff were quick to assist us in transferring inside and helped us carry our things

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Loved the quiet and stillness I experienced when I paid this cafe a visit. I tried the Espresso Spirit while I Was there and it was very refreshing. Ordered an Iced Americano for takeout and I noticed that their espresso is light & bright. Will try the hot drinks & desserts next time.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Not my first time here, but I recently had a strong craving for their caramel pecan cheesecake and let me tell you, they still nailed it! I think they’re the only one in the city that serves this, and it was just as rich, nutty, and delicious as I remembered. If I had one wish though... it would be for a bigger slice! It was sooo good but sooo tiny I could cry. 😅 Then again, maybe it’s the inflation and I totally get that baking ingredients aren’t cheap these days. The café has both indoor and outdoor garden seating, which is a nice option. But do note that the indoor seating is quite cramped...only two tables that are pretty close together. On the plus side, the strong coffee aroma wafting through the café was therapeutic and comforting (especially if you love coffee as much as I do). Only real downside: my cheesecake took several minutes to be served. Not a dealbreaker, but a bit of a wait for something so small, haha. Still a favorite spot for me, definitely worth the visit if you're after a cozy vibe and something sweet.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: I’m not really into cheesecakes but their cheesecake makes an exception. I love that they are not that sweet and the variant with the roasted pecan topping is divine. Their caffeinated drinks are also not that sweet and goes well with the cheesecake. Easily a recommended cafe in Davao City.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Food was great, I love their cup cake. What I really came for was the ambiance, ssooo cozy and secluded. Perfect for reading a book or stepping away from the mundane or chaos that life brings.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Looooove this place. Everything about it - coffee done right, cheesecakes done right, cozy, comfy, homey and just different from all other cafes because of the ambiance. ❤️

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Place was definitely cozy, with plenty of chairs for that al fresco vibe. Would have loved to stay but parkinv space only fits 2 cars, so very a downer. Drinks (matcha latte & some kind of peach drink) are fine, pecan cheesecake i love. Blueberry cheesecake makaumay though.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Café Prelaya is such a delightful spot 🌿☕ Their cheesecakes are truly the highlight—rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced in flavor. The café itself has a cozy and welcoming vibe, making it a great place to relax or catch up with friends. Staff are warm and attentive, which makes the experience even better. Definitely a must-visit for cheesecake and coffee lovers ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Laidback ambiance to grab a quick coffee. Looking forward for additional food options to partner their tasty drinks! ++pet friendly a plus

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: one of the best coffee shops i’ve been too. it’s too lowkey and underrated it deserves more hype ✨

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The place looks incredible, i went here with my family to try out their coffee and desserts, me and my family liked it so much. I suggest you go here at night or at dawn.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Absolutely delicious cheesecake! Very cozy vibe. Excellent coffee and service as well. A must try!

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Good place. Nice ambiance but food was so-so. Specially the pasta that was already cold and dry. They don’t prepare upon order, for sure.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: My personal best reading spot no. 2 here in Davao. Delicious bestseller cheesecake!!! Good drinks. One of the best customer service among other cafes in the city. Great place to hang with friends.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Great for chilling and relaxation. Good food esp the cheese cakes and good vibes..

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The barista staff is very kindly. I really enjoyed conversation with him. Thanks for your hospitality!

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Another addition to the growing list of Instagrammable coffee shops in Davao, this place looks the part but unfortunately doesn’t offer much beyond aesthetics. The drinks were average at best — the matcha latte was drinkable but lacked depth, and the hot chocolate tasted like something made from powdered mix. The menu felt uninspired.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Coffee: not a coffee connoisseur but the coffee was somewhat sour. I dont know where they source them or im just used to arabica beans that taste like rich chocolate🙏 4/10 Service: very tense staff ??? Atmosphere: i love the outdoor vibes, definitely something I would go back to, to just hangout. Plants are looking great 🌱

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Coffee was terrible. We ordered 4 DIFFERENT types of coffee and we all had the same opinion about it. Not sure if it was a one-time issue, Im still willing to give a try because the ambiance of the place is chill and relaxing. We’ll see… I heard the cakes were good, so maybe we will try that too.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Perferct place to chill and connect with friends. Cheesecake was 8/10

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: One sleepy waiter will try to do his work best he can (4 people, only bring 1 plate) and you will have to get the menu and order bu yourself inside the building although you decided to seat outside. Peacefull place. Barista was great and well offering their homemade cakes.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Had a last minute coffee hang with friends after dinner, and this popped out from reco places near us. Very nice cozy garden to drink your coffee and chat with friends. It was late at night and it wasn’t raining so we were able to enjoy the outdoor seating. Would have appreciated outdoor fans bec it was humid that night. Coffee was good for it’s price point.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Never fails to give 5 ⭐️ taste and service.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Great Service, Food and Ambience. Best part is Pets allowed 👏👌🐾🐶 …

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The hibiscus espresso tonic was so good 🥰 ambiance was windy too

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Having the options of indoor sitting or go al fresco is great! It is quite the change from the usual industrial ambiance of every café you would find in an urban area. They have great pastries to go with your coffee too, and their muffins are a must.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Very aesthetic place. Love to comeback here someday.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Has no wifi. The choco chip muffin are the best. Tonic Drinks are great too. Ambiance is perff. Staff are nice and cool.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Great coffee, staff and ambience. Just a few has great outdoor ambience in the city. They also have cookies and cheesecakes available.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Nice place, the coffee is great as well as the cakes. Will visit again soon. :) ♡

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Homey vibe, lots of plants, with skilled and friendly baristas. Great coffee.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Great cheesecake and coffee. Just wished they were open until 9PM, as it's tough to get there while they're still open after having dinner.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Sea salt coffee is a dream!

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Drinks were so so, nothing special.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Epic place. Instagrammable. Service awesome, very polite. Coffee is epic too.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Perfect for chilling.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: I love the place. Great for chikahan and study.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: It was a relaxing experience. We enjoyed it.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The food is good

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Very accomodating barista

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The best cafe to chikka & drink at.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Food, Drinks, Ambiance ✅💯

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Cheesecakes are to die for

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Their drinks, chocolate latte and matcha latte, are not too sweet. Outside seating is suitable for group meet ups. Just hope that it will not rain though as the indoor seating is limited

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Their cheesecake and coffee was superb! Plus great ambiance, perfect for fam and friends bonding.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: A lovely cafe surrounded by greenery. The interior is also unified with green, giving it a very tasteful feel. Apparently, it was designed by a famous designer in Davao. The food is also reasonably priced, making it a cafe with excellent cost performance.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Your cheesecake is awesome — I can't explain the taste, it's so delicious! 😭 If you open in Cebu, I swear I'll hang out there every day just to eat your cheesecake + Spanish coffee. THE BEST. I hope everyone has a legit coffee shop in their area.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The place is super nice. The vibes are just so chill. Because it's a little far from the main road, it's really good for long chit-chats ☺️ I totally recommend this place 🫶🏻

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Their pastries here are delicious. The ambiance is nice even though you're in the middle of the city.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: Sorry, but worst coffee I've tried here in DVO. AWFUL taste and smells like Chicken in tamarind broth (sinampalukang manok) huhu. Kuya said they use brazilian beans that's why they taste like that which is funny because brazilian beans aren't like that.

place_name: Café Prelaya by The Joaquins’ Cheesecakes
review_text: The people are super accommodating and very good customer service and a great place indeed 💚
